system.description:
If you are within 6 squares of a target and are armed with a Pistol or a Rifle, you can act as though you occupied the nearest square adjacent to the target for purposes of determining whether or not you or any allies are Flanking that target.

You may only be considered to be Flanking a single target at a time. You must spend a Swift Action on your turn to designate the target you Flank at range.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Scum and Villainy
